title: Softee Paddle Tennis Inflatable Barrier Player - Training
description:
SOFTEE PADEL TENNIS INFLATABLE BARRIER PLAYER - It is an ideal tool to improve precision and technique in padel or tennis training. The SOFTEE PADEL TENNIS INFLATABLE BARRIER PLAYER is designed in the shape of a paddle tennis player and allows you to simulate game situations, helping to work on the player's positioning and the precision of the shots.

It incorporates a 33 cm hole. in diameter, forcing the player to fine-tune their aim. Regarding the dimensions, once inflated, they would be: 183 x 89 cm.

As it is inflatable, it is very easy to transport, place and dismantle.
